description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainViewModel class for the Android application, managing UI-related data and interactions with underlying runtime components, preferences, and app states.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages UI state and coordinates interactions between the UI, preferences, and the underlying runtime component of the app.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches lifecycle and permission handling to the runtime's camera and SMS managers.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets the foreground status of the runtime.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name preference.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera usage.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the device location mode.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location sharing.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents device sleep.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual connection mode.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets the manual host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets the manual port number.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Sets the gateway authentication token.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets the bootstrap token for gateway connection.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for gateway access.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as complete and initializes runtime if true.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debugging.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification package forwarding mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding packages from a CSV string.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setVoiceScreenActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the voice screen.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles assistant launch requests, optionally auto-sending prompts.

methods.name: clearRequestedHomeDestination
methods.description: Clears the requested home destination state.

methods.name: clearChatDraft
methods.description: Clears the current chat draft.

methods.name: clearPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Clears auto-send prompt for assistant.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone.

methods.name: setSpeakerEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables speaker.

methods.name: refreshGatewayConnection
methods.description: Refreshes the gateway connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified gateway endpoint.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects using gateway endpoint with authentication tokens and password.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Connects manually to the gateway.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current gateway.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts the gateway trust prompt.

methods.name: declineGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines the gateway trust prompt.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIActionFromWebView
methods.description: Handles actions coming from webview payload JSON.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted canvas action URL.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate
methods.description: Requests canvas rehydration with a source parameter.

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes the home canvas overview if connected.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by session key.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes chat data.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes chat sessions with an optional limit.

methods.name: setChatThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the chat thinking level.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts the current chat.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional thinking text and attachments.

methods.description: Sends a chat message and waits for acceptance, returning success status.
